description: Randomization configuration for W1_Mar14 (auto-extracted from questionnaire.txt by generate_survey_prompt.py). Covers: (1) content_assignments — content placeholders, (2) option_order — shuffle answer-option codes within a question, (3) item_order — shuffle sub-items within grid/matrix questions, (4) form_randomization — reverse order of response options for a random half sample, (5) screen_order — multi-screen questions randomization
